v.why: With identity upstream the conv on edge 2 is the only learned transform on that path, so upgrading it matters more.
A conv-rich parallel route through node 2 already supplies capacity, making a direct conv redundant.
When the parallel route through node 2 is a weak pooling edge, the direct conv must carry more representational load.
A strong 3x3 sibling into node 3 makes a weak 1x1 on the direct edge add little.
A conv following a pooled edge into node 2 operates on blurred features and wastes capacity.
With an identity parent, the edge 5 conv is the only learned transform on the 0->2->3 route.
A direct shortcut into node 3 makes edge 5 prunable, so removing it costs less.
A strong direct conv makes the multi-hop edge 4 redundant under summation, so pruning it costs little.
A conv on the parallel route into node 2 substitutes for edge 2, so removing it is cheap.
A direct shortcut stabilizes optimization of the deeper conv stack so the upstream conv helps more.

raw:
I discarded the hypotheses whose condition disables or disconnects the edited component, and none had a condition equal to the edited edge's own value. The discarded ones were the four where edge 0 or edge 5 is set to none and the edit sits on a dead path, plus the edge-4-none condition on the edge 0 edit. Of the rest, I dropped the edge 2 / edge 0 avg_pool one because it repeats the edge 2 / edge 0 skip_connect mechanism. I also dropped three others (edge 3 none with edge 5 none, edge 0 conv with edge 3 none, edge 3 skip_connect with edge 0 none) to keep ten distinct mechanisms and field pairs.
